name: Multi-firewall layered outage diagnosis
prompt: Diagnose a service path crossing mock pfSense and OpenWrt devices. Correlate both rulesets with path evidence, navigate the five-level operations menu, identify the exact mismatch, and propose a reversible fix in answer.json.

lab.context: Traffic path: client -> pfSense -> WireGuard -> OpenWrt -> service 10.70.0.10.

commands.pfctl -sr: pfsense pass out on wg0 from 10.10.0.0/24 to 10.70.0.0/24 keep state max-mss 1360
commands.nft list ruleset: openwrt chain forward_wg { ip saddr 10.10.0.0/24 ip daddr 10.70.0.0/24 accept; }

menus.1>3>2>4>1:
Operations > Firewalls > OpenWrt > Interfaces > WireGuard
Interface MTU=1280 while tunnel path advertises MTU 1400; counters show fragmentation-needed drops
